lines.text: After two of Aaron's sons died, the LORD said Aaron must enter with a young bull and a ram.
Aaron takes two male goats from Israel and casts lots, one for the LORD and one for the scapegoat.
Aaron takes coals and incense behind the veil, sprinkling the bull's blood on the west side of the mercy seat.
Aaron lays both hands on the live goat, confesses Israel's sins, and a man sends it into the Red Sea.
On the tenth day of the seventh month, Israel must humble themselves, and atonement is made once a year.
